The subprocess path WAS exercised for the refusal branch (exit 2). This reproduces, rather than accepts on trust, the maker's declared gap 1.
The UI genuinely has no ingest route (persist_ingest/ingest_video appear only in cli_video.py) — verified by grep. So the video seam has one door, not two; the crawl seam has both.
